name: Social media · IG grid
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Social media · IG grid.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Add and arrange your own content using the blocks below. Profile links open the original site. This section does not automatically import posts.

settings.label: Enable section
settings.how: Turn on “Enable section” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Kicker
settings.how: Enter the kicker. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Heading
settings.default: See what we’re sharing on Instagram
settings.how: Enter the heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Body text
settings.default: Highlight your latest posts, behind-the-scenes moments, and UGC in a simple manual grid.
settings.how: Write the body text. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Text alignment
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for text alignment. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Columns on desktop
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust columns on desktop. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Columns on mobile
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust columns on mobile. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Grid gap (px)
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust grid gap (px). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Tile aspect ratio
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for tile aspect ratio. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Card style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for card style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Show caption under image
settings.how: Turn on “Show caption under image” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Caption max lines
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust caption max lines. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Hover overlay mode
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for hover overlay mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Overlay icon
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for overlay icon. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Open links in a new tab
settings.how: Turn on “Open links in a new tab” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: ARIA label for section
settings.how: Enter the aria label for section. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Image
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Image alt text
settings.how: Enter the image alt text. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Caption
settings.how: Write the caption. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Link URL (optional)
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Link ARIA label
settings.how: Enter the link aria label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Overlay text (optional)
settings.how: Enter the overlay text (optional). Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.
